entities.summary: Albert Zafy's Third Republic, a political institution in Madagascar during Democratic Madagascar and Political Crises (1991–2001). Grew from Biodiversity and Environmental Challenges and Malagasy Socialist Revolution. Led to the emergence of Third Republic and Zafy-Ratsiraka Rivalry and Ravalomanana Presidency.
